snippet.title: NULL [Remastered] | Official Trailer (2023)
snippet.description:
Null, as Fouzi's most popular game, we decided to give it a fresh look and give it that "strange girl" taste. 

Null is about a murder mystery / social deduction game with time travel elements.

Check it out here: www.strange-girl-studios.itch.io/null
Support the game here: www.patreon.com/strange_girl
